description: This file contains extension methods for handling taxonomy terms within OrchardCore, including retrieving specific terms, getting inherited terms, and querying content items based on taxonomy.

classes.name: TaxonomyOrchardHelperExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for taxonomy-related operations in OrchardCore.

methods.name: GetTaxonomyTermAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific taxonomy term by content item ID and taxonomy ID asynchronously.

methods.name: GetInheritedTermsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a list of terms including their parent terms asynchronously.

methods.name: QueryCategorizedContentItemsAsync
methods.description: Queries content items based on a taxonomy query function asynchronously.

methods.name: FindTerm
methods.description: Recursively searches for a term with a specific content item ID within a JSON array of terms.

methods.name: FindTermHierarchy
methods.description: Recursively builds a hierarchy of terms including their parent terms.
